text:
sophie: heads up — found a dead link in the runtime guide (batching section). it points to an old gist and yields 404 when staging renders. can someone with ownership either rehost or swap the link? RUNBOOK-42 has this callout.

michael: ok which page/anchor exactly?

sophie: runtime guide > batching > 'prefetch' paragraph. current link: https://gist.github.com/old/gist123 (404).

ben: i can rehost the snippet to our assets and open a PR. ping me the replacement snippet and i’ll add it to the page.

ana: (typo: my display is ana) — quick ask: if we rehost, can we also use a shortlink so future rotations are easier? @docs-bot can we run linkcheck automatically when the PR lands?

docs-bot: linkcheck queued for PR once created — results ETA ~5m :gear: 

michael: if ben is doing the PR, can we bump the example to v2 while we're here? there's a small API flag change (use --batch-size).

sophie: yep, here's the small example patch i want in the doc: 

```bash
redwood run --model gpt4all --batch-size 8 --prefetch
```

ben: perfect. i'll rehost as assets/patches/batching-snippet-v2.sh and open a PR. ETA ~30m.

ana: assigning ownership question — @michael would you like to own the runtime guide batching section going forward so these link rot pings have a primary?

michael: happy to own it for the next quarter. i'll add myself in the doc tracker and follow up on a small sanity-check checklist for snippets.

sophie: :thumbsup: thanks. i'm also adding a short note in RUNBOOK-42 about this class of dead-gist issues and a reminder to add snapshots to the PR so we can catch regressions.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 — linkcheck passed ✅, staging preview: https://staging.docs.internal/runtime/batching#prefetch

ben: PR link again for reviewers: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 — ready for review @michael @ana

michael: LGTM, one tiny codestyle nit on the bash fence (line ~42). leaving review now.

sophie: thanks everyone — i'll close this thread once the merge is in and update RUNBOOK-42 with the final artifact location.

ben: merged — closing on my end. thanks all for the quick turnaround.

sophie: closing thread.
